The issuer shows significant financial distress, characterized by a negative net income of -23M, severely accumulated deficits (retained earnings of -1,065M), and negative shareholders' equity of -496M (technical insolvency). While the company remains operational with 2,800M in revenue and a razor-thin current ratio of 1.02, its highly leveraged capital structure (liabilities exceeding assets) indicates a very high credit risk and substantial vulnerability to default. Based on these highly leveraged and distressed credit metrics, the issuer falls into the highly speculative CCC range.

DECISION: CCC+
